roll_rule: Reuse scripts/oos_preparation/adapter.py determine_roll unchanged: first boundary-qualified completed session with incoming volume strictly above outgoing; activate next session. No strategy inputs.
completeness_guard: Require at least one preceding qualifying outgoing-dominant day. Missing incoming no-trade minutes are not imputed. Report all minute gaps, do not demand full incoming coverage before it becomes liquid.

calendar.scope: Ordinary weekday Globex sessions only, 18:00 previous civil NY day to 17:00. No Christmas-period inference. NQZ25 expiration Dec19 09:30 NY is separately excluded from full-day cleanliness claims.
calendar.limitation: Reconstructed ordinary-session grid, not independently signed historical exchange calendar. Adapter intentionally preserves frozen convention.
